rationale: Procurement policy directorate: annual reports, standard forms, EU-tender category — durable national A2 hub.
SAI audit reports itemise contracts and values, but URL check failed and legal status unclear — recheck liveness.
Parliament's annual procurement plan page: recurring forward-looking pipeline signal, standalone on its domain.
Municipal utility procurement page; utilities buy billing/cash-collection/payment-acceptance systems — recurring in-scope notices.
Think-tank stream with running commentary on procurement aggregates and direct awards — continuous analytical signal.
TED gives structured, machine-readable Montenegro award notices with supplier and value; independent of CEJN scraping.
Category feed within ujn.gov.me already captured by monitoring the parent directorate site.
Central gov portal publishes award decisions and hosts procurement PDFs — catch-all channel for bodies outside CEJN.
Static contract-document folder is a useful harvest pattern but URL verification failed; recheck before approving.
Business press is the earliest human-readable signal of large awards and names suppliers; moderate credibility.
Banking/payments trade press — only visible channel for private-bank vendor selections not covered by registers.
Bank notices announce card-scheme and payment-product launches — best private-sector award proxy; pattern repeats across ME banks.
Single EU-integration article describing CEJN scope; good citation, not a recurring signal producer.
Licensed-bank register defines the buyer population to mine; enumerate once, refresh periodically.
Hub index over the four CBCG payment registers, each captured separately below.
Payment institutions + agents register: the non-bank acquirer/PSP buyer seed set for terminals and gateways.
E-money institution register identifies EMI/fintech buyers of issuing, KYC and terminal services.
Revoked-authorisation negative list; prunes dead actors and dates market exits between snapshots.
Payment-system operators register — small, high-value population buying switching, clearing and settlement infrastructure.
Central transaction-account register supports entity resolution of awardees and bank-corporate mapping.
Blocked-accounts search is a due-diligence screen on bidders/awardees, not a continuous tender signal.
Master company register: backbone for resolving bidder/awardee names into legal entities; legal status to confirm.
Alternative CRPS access path via tax administration, but URL verification failed — recheck reachability.
